## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `SetupGuide`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `mssql-setup-guide`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **SetupGuide**.

## Step 2: Create a database and user

1. <!-- manual: Connect to your SQL Server instance using SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS), Azure Data Studio, or sqlcmd. -->
2. <!-- manual: Create a new database: -->
3. <!-- manual: Create a login and user with appropriate permissions: -->

## Step 3: Enable TCP/IP connectivity

1. <!-- manual: Open SQL Server Configuration Manager. -->
2. <!-- manual: Navigate to SQL Server Network Configuration › Protocols for [your instance]. -->
3. Ensure **TCP/IP** is **Enabled**.
4. <!-- manual: Under TCP/IP Properties › IP Addresses, verify the port is set to 1433 (or your custom port). -->
5. <!-- manual: Restart the SQL Server service for changes to take effect. -->

## Step 4: Enable change data capture for CDC triggers (optional)

1. <!-- manual: Enable CDC on the database: -->
2. <!-- manual: Enable CDC on the tables you want to track: -->
3. Verify that the SQL Server Agent service is running, as CDC relies on it.

## Step 5: Configure SSL/TLS (optional)

1. <!-- manual: Obtain or generate an SSL certificate for the SQL Server instance. -->
2. <!-- manual: Open SQL Server Configuration Manager › SQL Server Network Configuration › Protocols. -->
3. Right-click **Properties** > **Flags** tab and set **Force Encryption** to **Yes**.
4. <!-- manual: Right-click Properties › Flags tab -->
5. <!-- manual: Under the Certificate tab, select your SSL certificate. -->
6. <!-- manual: Restart the SQL Server service. -->
